steps: Pick an original practice landscape and season, then open the object library to choose crops, buildings and paths.
Paint or place objects, toggle sprinkler coverage, and inspect collisions. Use undo or select multiple objects before moving them.
Download editable JSON or a PNG image. A separate private workspace is required for saved projects and personal screenshots.
example: Place nine crop markers around an iridium sprinkler on an unobstructed practice grid. Turn on water coverage to see which crop cells are reached; the sprinkler occupies its own tile.
faq: Can I plan a Stardew Valley farm layout on mobile?
The canvas supports tap to place, pan and pinch zoom, with compact controls.
Are these the exact game maps?
No. The eight landscapes and indoor templates are independently authored practice scenes. Actual terrain and building compatibility are not fully verified.

steps: Select a Community Center room, or search a bundle by the item you need.
Read the required number of candidate slots, quantity and minimum quality before marking a donation.
Filter incomplete bundles by season and export the checklist.
bundles.example: If a bundle requires any three of five candidates, three fully donated qualifying slots complete it. Partial quantities do not complete a slot.
faq: Do I need every optional bundle item?
No. The required slot count determines completion; some bundles offer a choice.
Are remixed bundles automatically detected?
No. Standard bundle progress is not applied to unknown remixed or modded combinations.

steps: Search artifacts or minerals and narrow by source.
Record an item as found when acquired and as donated only after delivering it to Gunther.
Review donation milestones and export progress.
museum.example: Mark one newly found mineral as Found only. The ready-to-donate count increases but the museum donation total does not. Mark Donated after delivering it.
faq: How many museum donations are tracked?
The reference catalogue contains 42 artifacts and 53 minerals, 95 unique donations.
Does finding an item count as donating it?
No. The tracker keeps these separate; reward eligibility is also distinct from claiming the reward.

steps: Review version and platform requirements before attempting seed prediction.
Select a geode or artifact trove to see possible missing museum entries.
Record verified donations in the museum tool; do not use the source list as an opening-order forecast.
predictor.example: Selecting Geode lists entries that have a recorded geode source. It does not say which item will appear in your next geode.
faq: Can I predict my next geode?
Not in this preview. No approved RNG adapter or independent game fixture is available.
Is this a world seed generator?
No. Seed prediction and map generation are different tasks.

steps: Only a separately configured workspace can accept a main SaveGame XML file.
Review the version, main-player fields and recognized collection counts before confirming the local merge.
Compare collection totals and load observed XP or earnings into their calculators; export a local backup.
tracker.example: A recognized cooked recipe with a positive count can mark the recipe complete. A missing field does not prove zero completion.
faq: Does a game save leave my device?
The private workspace reads supported fields locally and never uploads the raw file to our server.
Can I mix multiple farms?
Not safely in this preview. Use one farm per local workspace and export a backup before changing farms.

steps: Choose an outdoor season, day, available tiles and seed budget.
Run the planting optimizer and compare per-tile profit, remaining-day profit and seed ROI.
Enter available machines and cash assumptions to inspect a simplified daily economy.
crop-calculator.example: One parsnip seed costs 20g and sells at 35g normal quality. Planting on day 1 yields a day 5 harvest and 15g net before other costs.
faq: Which crop is most profitable?
It depends on planting day, available seeds, budget, and regrowth. Compare the supported crop rows for your assumptions.
Do these results include fertilizer or random extra yields?
The base seasonal model uses normal-quality minimum yields; processing and professions are limited to the separate economy model.

steps: Choose a category, quality and actual sale value for each of up to nine items.
Enter candidate quantities to find the highest-scoring feasible display under the reference formula.
Apply the suggested selection, inspect category and item points, and adjust manually.
fair-calculator.example: One active normal-quality item worth 400g earns six item points. Without a recognized category bonus the displayed reference score is 14 − 7 + 6 = 13.
faq: How many points win first place?
The reference model uses 90 points for first place.
Can I reuse an item in the recommendation?
Only up to the quantity you enter. The optimizer cannot inspect actual inventory.

steps: Search names and recorded acquisition conditions.
Select a main-route season and distinguish found from caught entries.
Review incomplete fish and export the collection record.
fishing.example: Filter by spring and search for a fish name; total collection progress remains independent of the visible list.
faq: Does this list include Legendary Fish II?
No. The reference collection excludes challenge-only legendary variants.
Are all weather and bait alternatives modeled?
No. The current hints describe common routes; exact weather, time and bait coverage is incomplete.

steps: Enter verified completion for each category; leave unobserved categories unknown.
The lower bound counts only recorded values; the upper bound allows full completion of unknown categories.
Use the related collection trackers and load saved manual counts in the private workspace.
perfection.example: 77 of 154 shipping entries contribute 7.5 of 15 percentage points under the reference formula. Unrecorded categories remain unknown.
faq: Does this calculate exact in-game perfection?
It is a proportional reference estimate with explicit unknowns; in-game rounding and multiplayer rules are not fully modeled.
What do waivers cost?
The reference calculator uses 500,000g per waiver point and caps the final score at 100%.

steps: Search crafting recipes and distinguish learned from crafted.
Select how many crafting batches you plan and inspect required direct materials.
Enter owned materials and optional prices; export the shortages and ingredient plan.
crafting.example: For two identical crafting batches, every direct ingredient quantity is doubled. Output quantity may be greater than two if a recipe produces multiple units.
faq: Does learning a crafting recipe count toward completion?
No. The item must actually have been crafted.
Are profession substitutions expanded?
The standard recipe list does not automatically apply every profession or recursive ingredient substitution.

steps: Record completion after the relevant in-game shipping action rather than merely acquiring an item.
Filter incomplete entries and export the record.
shipping.example: Finding a Parsnip alone does not complete the shipping entry; mark it complete after the relevant shipping action.
faq: How many items are tracked?
The reference target is 154 produce and forage shipping entries.
Does every sale count?
No. Selling to a shop and the collection's shipping condition are not necessarily equivalent.

steps: Find a dish by name or ingredient.
Enter the number of meals to cook and inspect direct ingredients.
Compare stock with requirements and record dishes actually cooked.
cooking.example: Two Fried Egg batches require two eggs. Owning the recipe alone does not complete the cooking record.
faq: How many cooking recipes are listed?
81 reference recipes are included.
Does the ingredient planner recursively expand dishes?
No. Direct ingredients and group names are shown; intermediate dishes are not automatically expanded.

steps: Review the listed sources and reveal puzzle hints only when needed.
Record fixed rewards and repeated sources separately.
Use the balance ledger; lifetime walnuts and spendable balance are different.
golden-walnuts.example: If you have found 30 lifetime walnuts and spent 10, the available balance is 20 under that manual ledger.
faq: How many Golden Walnuts are in the reference target?
130 total. The manual tracker separates repeated drops and fixed tasks.
Does the tracker locate every walnut from a save?
No. The current source descriptions and counts do not reconstruct exact game positions or all save events.

steps: Select two farms to compare reference tillable and buildable counts.
Read each farm's terrain and playstyle characteristics.
Follow the corresponding link to start practicing in the planner.
farm-comparison.example: Compare Standard with Beach using the reference tillable counts, but remember that beach sand and terrain constraints limit sprinkler use.
faq: Which farm has the most tillable tiles in the reference table?
Standard has 3,427 listed tillable tiles.
Are the linked maps exact farm maps?
No. Each is an independently authored landscape inspired by a general terrain type, not an official map.

steps: Enter lifetime earnings, total skill levels and friendships.
Select only confirmed in-game achievements; Community Center completion and ceremony are distinct.
Inspect the score and remaining points to four candles.
grandpa-calculator.example: A lifetime earnings input of 1,000,000g contributes seven income points in the reference calculation.
faq: How many points earn four candles?
At least 12 reference points.
Can I load a save?
In the private workspace you can explicitly load recognized earnings and skill XP-derived levels; remaining achievements are manual.

steps: Record XP for each of the five skills or load observed main-player XP in the private workspace.
Inspect level, XP to next level and profession branches.
Record mastery points independently; export or save local progress.
skills.example: At 15,000 skill XP, the reference threshold table reports level 10.
faq: How many base skills are there?
Five: Farming, Mining, Foraging, Fishing and Combat.
Does the tool award professions in game?
No. It models thresholds and shows branches, without writing to the original save.
